name: @pmlpm/pi-translate-zh-en
description: Pi extension: bidirectional zh<->en translation to save tokens. Translates user Chinese input to English before sending to the model, and translates the model's English response back to Chinese. All-in-one replacement for pi-prompt-translate (input side)
